ADC.note: Clear the *carry flag* with **`CLC`** before adding the first byte in a sequence. On CMOS 65C02 variants, decimal mode (**`D`**=1) sets **N** and **Z** accurately and adds 1 extra cycle.

ASL.note: CMOS 65C02 performs a dummy read rather than the NMOS dummy write on read-modify-write instructions.

BIT.note: Immediate mode (`BIT #imm`) updates only the **Z** flag and leaves **N** and **V** unchanged.

BRK.note: CMOS 65C02 clears the **D** (decimal) flag to 0 after pushing `P`, ensuring interrupts execute in binary mode.

DEC.note: CMOS 65C02 adds `DEC A` (also written `DEC` with no operand or `DEA`) and performs a dummy read rather than the NMOS dummy write.

INC.note: CMOS 65C02 adds `INC A` (also written `INC` with no operand or `INA`) and performs a dummy read rather than the NMOS dummy write.

JMP.note: CMOS 65C02 fixes the NMOS indirect page-boundary wrap bug on `JMP ($xxFF)` (adding 1 cycle to `Indirect` mode).

LSR.note: CMOS 65C02 performs a dummy read rather than the NMOS dummy write on read-modify-write instructions.

ROL.note: CMOS 65C02 performs a dummy read rather than the NMOS dummy write on read-modify-write instructions.

ROR.note: CMOS 65C02 performs a dummy read rather than the NMOS dummy write on read-modify-write instructions.

SBC.note: Set the *carry flag* with **`SEC`** before subtracting the first byte in a sequence. On CMOS 65C02 variants, decimal mode (**`D`**=1) sets **N** and **Z** accurately and adds 1 extra cycle.

BRA.description: Unconditionally branches to a target within -128 to +127 bytes of the next instruction.

DEA.description: `ca65` alias for `DEC A`. Subtracts 1 from the *accumulator*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

INA.description: `ca65` alias for `INC A`. Adds 1 to the *accumulator*.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the result is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the result is 0, cleared otherwise.

PHX.description: Pushes a copy of the **X** index register onto the stack.

PHY.description: Pushes a copy of the **Y** index register onto the stack.

PLX.description: Pulls a value from the stack into the **X** index register.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the pulled value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the pulled value is 0, cleared otherwise.

PLY.description: Pulls a value from the stack into the **Y** index register.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the pulled value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the pulled value is 0, cleared otherwise.

STZ.description: Writes `$00` directly into memory without modifying any CPU registers or status flags.

TRB.description: Tests memory with the *accumulator* (`A AND mem`) to set **Z**, then clears every bit in memory that is 1 in `A` (`mem := mem AND (NOT A)`).

flagChanges.Z: Set if (`A AND mem`) before modification is 0, cleared otherwise.

TSB.description: Tests memory with the *accumulator* (`A AND mem`) to set **Z**, then sets every bit in memory that is 1 in `A` (`mem := mem OR A`).

flagChanges.Z: Set if (`A AND mem`) before modification is 0, cleared otherwise.

STP.description: Halts the internal system clock, putting the processor into static low-power standby until a hardware `RES` reset.

WAI.description: Suspends instruction execution until a hardware interrupt (`IRQ`, `NMI`, or `RES`) is asserted, minimizing interrupt latency.

ADC.note: Clear **C** with **`CLC`** before multi-word addition. Unlike the 65C02, the 65816 performs BCD without an extra cycle.

BRA.description: Unconditionally branches to a target within -128 to +127 bytes. In Native mode (`E`=0), page crossings incur no extra cycle.

BRK.note: In Native mode (`E`=0), `BRK` pushes `PBR`, 16-bit `PC`, and `P` (8 cycles total) and clears **D**=0. In `ca65`, an optional signature byte may be supplied (`brk $00`).

DEC.note: Writes only once (no dummy write). `DEC A` / `DEA` always takes 2 cycles regardless of **M**.

DEA.description: `ca65` alias for `DEC A`. Subtracts 1 from the 8-bit or 16-bit *accumulator*.

INC.note: Writes only once (no dummy write). `INC A` / `INA` always takes 2 cycles regardless of **M**.

INA.description: `ca65` alias for `INC A`. Adds 1 to the 8-bit or 16-bit *accumulator*.

JMP.note: `JMP ($abs)` always takes 5 cycles on 65816 with the indirect page-boundary bug fixed. 24-bit `JMP long` and `JMP [abs]` are aliases for `JML`.

RTI.description: Returns from an interrupt by pulling `P`, `PC`, and (in Native mode `E`=0) `PBR` from the stack.

SBC.note: Set **C** with **`SEC`** before multi-word subtraction. Unlike the 65C02, the 65816 performs BCD without an extra cycle.

BRL.description: Unconditionally branches to a target within -32768 to +32767 bytes within the current 64KB program bank.

COP.description: Triggers the COP interrupt vector, pushing `PBR` (in Native mode), 16-bit `PC`, and `P` onto the stack. Takes an immediate signature byte (`cop $00` in `ca65`).

JML.description: Unconditionally sets both the Program Bank Register (`PBR`) and Program Counter (`PC`) to a 24-bit target address.

JSL.description: Pushes the current 24-bit return address (`PBR` and `PC - 1`) onto the stack and jumps to a 24-bit subroutine address.

MVN.description: Copies `C + 1` bytes from `srcBank:X` to `dstBank:Y`, incrementing `X` and `Y` and decrementing `C` (`16-bit A`). Syntax in `ca65`: `mvn src, dst`.
MVN.note: Executes 7 clock cycles per byte transferred (`7 * (C + 1)` total) and updates `DBR` to `dstBank`.

MVP.description: Copies `C + 1` bytes from `srcBank:X` to `dstBank:Y`, decrementing `X`, `Y`, and `C` (`16-bit A`). Syntax in `ca65`: `mvp src, dst`.
MVP.note: Executes 7 clock cycles per byte transferred (`7 * (C + 1)` total) and updates `DBR` to `dstBank`.

PEA.description: Pushes a 16-bit immediate constant/address operand onto the stack without altering registers or flags (written `pea $1234` in `ca65`).

PEI.description: Reads a 16-bit pointer from Direct Page memory and pushes it onto the stack (written `pei ($10)` in `ca65`).

PER.description: Adds a signed 16-bit offset to the updated `PC` and pushes the resulting 16-bit address onto the stack.

PHB.description: Pushes the 8-bit Data Bank Register (`DBR`) onto the stack.

PHD.description: Pushes the 16-bit Direct Page Register (`D`) onto the stack.

PHK.description: Pushes the 8-bit Program Bank Register (`PBR`) onto the stack.

PLB.description: Pulls an 8-bit value from the stack into the Data Bank Register (`DBR`).

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the pulled byte is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the pulled byte is 0, cleared otherwise.

PLD.description: Pulls a 16-bit value from the stack into the Direct Page Register (`D`).

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of the pulled word is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the pulled word is 0, cleared otherwise.

REP.description: Clears bits in the Processor Status Register (`P`) where the immediate operand bit is 1. Commonly used with `.a16`/`.i16` (`rep #$20`, `rep #$10`, `rep #$30`) to enable 16-bit modes.

flagChanges.P: Bits set in the immediate mask are cleared to 0 (`M` and `X` switch `A`/`X`/`Y` to 16-bit in Native mode).

RTL.description: Pulls a 16-bit `PC` and 8-bit `PBR` pushed by `JSL` and resumes execution at `PC + 1` in the caller's bank.

SEP.description: Sets bits in the Processor Status Register (`P`) where the immediate operand bit is 1. Commonly used with `.a8`/`.i8` (`sep #$20`, `sep #$10`, `sep #$30`) to enable 8-bit modes.

flagChanges.P: Bits set in the immediate mask are set to 1 (`M` and `X` switch `A`/`X`/`Y` to 8-bit).

STP.description: Halts the internal system clock until a hardware `RES` reset occurs.

SWA.description: `ca65` alias for `XBA`. Exchanges the low (`A`) and high (`B`) bytes of the 16-bit `C` accumulator.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the new low byte (`A`) is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the new low byte (`A`) is 0, cleared otherwise.

TAD.fullName: Transfer C Accumulator to Direct Page
TAD.description: `ca65` alias for `TCD`. Transfers the 16-bit `C` accumulator into the Direct Page Register (`D`).

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of `D` is 1, cleared otherwise.

TAS.fullName: Transfer C Accumulator to Stack Pointer
TAS.description: `ca65` alias for `TCS`. Transfers the 16-bit `C` accumulator into the Stack Pointer (`S`).

TCD.fullName: Transfer C Accumulator to Direct Page
TCD.description: Transfers the full 16-bit `C` (`B:A`) accumulator into the Direct Page Register (`D`), regardless of the **M** flag.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of `D` is 1, cleared otherwise.

TCS.fullName: Transfer C Accumulator to Stack Pointer
TCS.description: Transfers the 16-bit `C` accumulator into the Stack Pointer (`S`). In Emulation mode (`E`=1), the high byte of `S` remains `$01`.

TDA.fullName: Transfer Direct Page to C Accumulator
TDA.description: `ca65` alias for `TDC`. Transfers the 16-bit Direct Page Register (`D`) into the `C` accumulator.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of `C` is 1, cleared otherwise.

TDC.fullName: Transfer Direct Page to C Accumulator
TDC.description: Transfers the 16-bit Direct Page Register (`D`) into the full 16-bit `C` accumulator, regardless of the **M** flag.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of `C` is 1, cleared otherwise.

TSA.fullName: Transfer Stack Pointer to C Accumulator
TSA.description: `ca65` alias for `TSC`. Transfers the 16-bit Stack Pointer (`S`) into the `C` accumulator.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of `C` is 1, cleared otherwise.

TSC.fullName: Transfer Stack Pointer to C Accumulator
TSC.description: Transfers the 16-bit Stack Pointer (`S`) into the 16-bit `C` accumulator, regardless of the **M** flag.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 15 of `C` is 1, cleared otherwise.

TXY.description: Copies the value in **X** into **Y** (8-bit or 16-bit depending on the **X** flag).

flagChanges.N: Set if the MSB (bit 7 or bit 15) of the transferred value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the transferred value is 0, cleared otherwise.

TYX.description: Copies the value in **Y** into **X** (8-bit or 16-bit depending on the **X** flag).

flagChanges.N: Set if the MSB (bit 7 or bit 15) of the transferred value is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the transferred value is 0, cleared otherwise.

WAI.description: Suspends execution until a hardware interrupt (`IRQ`, `NMI`, or `RES`) occurs.

WDM.description: Reserved 2-byte no-op opcode (`wdm $00` in `ca65`). Commonly used as an emulator/debugger software trap.

XBA.description: Swaps the low byte (`A`) and high byte (`B`) of the 16-bit `C` accumulator, regardless of the **M** flag.

flagChanges.N: Set if bit 7 of the new low byte (`A`) is 1, cleared otherwise.
flagChanges.Z: Set if the new low byte (`A`) is 0, cleared otherwise.

XCE.description: Exchanges the **C** (carry) flag with the hidden **E** (emulation mode) flag. Use `clc; xce` to enter 65816 Native mode (`E`=0) or `sec; xce` to enter 6502 Emulation mode (`E`=1).

flagChanges.E: Set to previous value of **C** (`0` = Native, `1` = Emulation).
